answer: Think of Sapphire grader carved cameo seal witnessed by the stone board as a toll booth: each carved cameo is a measured facet angle plus a guild signature, so a farm must grade a hundred real sapphires by hand, so the lotus of passing is trivial for one agent and ruinous for a thousand clones. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The inlet is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The canyon is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
